$comment: TRANSCRIBED from plugins/json_source/json_source_keys.h + _io.h. json_source is a generic injector whose EMITTED data plane is an OPEN schema by design (docs/new_gen/02), and whose control surface is deliberately string-shaped: the Config splices RAW user JSON under "data", set_data carries arbitrary JSON, and the per-emit Patch shape ({key,value} single or {patches:[...]} batch) is open-valued. None of that is in the constrained typed-field family the generator emits, so this decl sets "handwritten_io": true — the generator owns the KEY contract (_keys.gen.h) but json_source_io.h stays hand-written (codegen-gap note in docs/new_gen/08, contract/codegen/README.md). The patch key names ride "inputs" ONLY so collect_keys mints their k-constants (a source's inputs never become schema slots or TS/Py types).
title: json_source — user-authored JSON injector (open output; typed control surface).

config.doc: string — the user's JSON document, spliced raw under "data"

inputs.doc: array of {key,value} — per-emit patches (open value; hand-written builder)
